description: RSAF Vampire FB.52 painted 515 mapped by aerialvisuals at 21.59796 39.14459 on Prince Sultan Road, Al-Salamah, Jeddah, together with one unidentified airframe. The institution is not identified; a 2019 blog says two ex-Kandara Vampire instructional airframes went to the engineering faculty of King Abdulaziz University, which is elsewhere in the city. Needs a site visit.
